about_the_game:
This is a demo for the upcoming full game.

In this demo, you will experience the core mechanics of the game by spending one night in the security control room of a vast space battleship.

The year is 20XX. As an astronaut assigned to monitor unexplained anomalies, your mission is to watch over the ship while the rest of the crew is away on an expedition. From midnight to 03:00 A.M., you must observe every corner of the vessel through CCTV cameras, detecting and reporting even the slightest change.

[What's in the Demo]

  • Your First Night on Duty: Play through the complete mission for the first night, serving as the introduction to the game.

  • Core Sector Surveillance: Your observation duties will cover a few key sectors of the ship.

  • A Glimpse of Anomalies: Encounter a selection of the anomalies that will be featured in the full game and learn how to use the reporting system.

  • Core Gameplay Loop: Experience the entire basic gameplay flow: monitoring CCTV feeds in real-time, spotting changes, and submitting reports.

Survive the night by using your keen sense of observation to fulfill your duty. If you enjoy the demo, please be sure to Wishlist the full game to stay updated on its release!

short_description: This is a CCTV simulation game where you become an astronaut in the distant future, discovering and reporting abnormal phenomena. Check and memorize various maps, and don't miss any abnormal phenomena. Because as the number of abnormalities increases, your life could be in danger.
